scope: Independent source-bound review of identity, research question, method, findings, limitations, literal quotations and controlled-category relevance. This receipt grants no human verification or publication authority.

findings.finding: Gender is incorrectly omitted. The experiment deliberately varies gender and sexual-identity labels, including transgender women and intersectional Black transgender women, and analyzes resulting recommendation differences. This is an explicit gender perspective under the controlled category definition, not incidental demographic reporting.
The 500 vignettes, control plus 31 labels, adversarial false-chart element, 65 percent hallucination rate and 7.67 percent mitigated rate agree with the source.
The single quotation is exact and the snapshot and no-significance-testing limits are accurate. Figures were not independently inspected.
